claim: Art Institute of Chicago general admission is $32 for non-resident adults and $26 for seniors/students/teens 14-17; Illinois residents save $5 and Chicago residents save $12, with free Illinois-resident hours on Free Summer Thursdays 5-8pm June 11-Sept 17, 2026.

Chicago's major museums each run Illinois-resident free days in 2026: Field Museum free Wednesdays, Shedd free evenings, Adler free Wednesday evenings, plus winter weekday free dates at the Art Institute.
quote: Free Museum Days In 2026: The Adler, Art Institute, Shedd And More

claim: Adler Planetarium basic Museum Entry starts in the high-$20s for adults, with extended Wednesday evening hours (4-10pm) when Museum Entry is typically free for Illinois residents showing proof of residency.
quote: Adler runs extended hours from 4 p.m. to 10 p.m., and during those Wednesday evening sessions, Museum Entry is typically free for Illinois residents

claim: Chicago CityPASS costs $144 adult / $114 child (May 2026) bundling Shedd Aquarium, Skydeck plus three more choices for an advertised $287 value; the cheaper Chicago C3 is $109 adult / $79 child.
quote: The full CityPASS costs $144 for adults and $114 for children... Chicago C3 option that's more affordable: $109 for adults and $79 for children

claim: Chicago CityPASS delivers triple-digit savings only when all five admissions are used and the trip already includes Shedd and Skydeck; it is not worth it for one- or two-attraction trips or for locals using resident discounts.
quote: It's not ideal for one- or two-attraction trips, locals using resident discounts, or travelers who do not want both Shedd and Skydeck

claim: Second City Chicago shows range roughly $30-$100, with a weekly Ten Dollar Comedy showcase at $10 and Mainstage Revue tickets starting higher.
quote: Ten Dollar Comedy is a weekly showcase featuring some of Chicago's best stand-up and improv comedy – all for only $10

claim: Griffin Museum of Science and Industry adult (12+) general admission runs roughly $26-$38, and Illinois residents receive free general admission on select dates including June 4 and June 19, 2026 (Dome films excluded).
quote: Illinois residents receive free General Admission on select days of the year... Giant Dome Theater films and certain special experiences are not included

claim: Museum of Contemporary Art Chicago offers free admission to Illinois residents on Tuesday evenings 5-9pm throughout 2026, is always free for under-18s, and operates a pay-what-you-can policy.
quote: Illinois residents can enjoy free admission at the Museum of Contemporary Art on Tuesday evenings from 5 p.m. to 9 p.m.

claim: Reviewer and Reddit consensus names the Art Institute of Chicago the single best museum in the city and a top-tier world art museum, with the Field Museum the second standout natural-history pick.
quote: if you only have time for one, make it the Art Institute of Chicago—it's consistently ranked among the best in the world

claim: On Chicago's lakefront Museum Campus the Field Museum, Shedd Aquarium and Adler Planetarium sit within a 5-15 minute walk of each other on paved paths, supporting a half-day-each itinerary.
quote: Field Museum to Shedd Aquarium is approximately a 5-7 minute walk, and the Field Museum to Adler Planetarium is approximately a 10-15 minute walk

claim: Field Museum standard online general admission starts around $30 for out-of-town adults with discounted Chicago/Illinois resident rates, and is free Wednesdays for Illinois residents.
